_comment: One simulated uc2_cam_py camera (camTest_config.yaml) through the camera manager, which runs on real hardware only. Needs the extra camera (uv sync --extra camera). Boot with: NEWSWITCH_CONFIG=configs/camTest.json uvicorn main:app --port 8069. Stage and illumination look for a UC2 board and keep retrying without one. Runtime values are saved to camTest_config.persistent.yaml, so the main persistent file stays untouched.
